description: This file defines a custom CookieAuthenticationEvents class that handles token validation, specifically to revoke user sessions based on cache entries. It overrides the ValidatePrincipal method to check if the user's authentication should be invalidated.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: Custom cookie authentication event handler that revokes user sessions based on cache entries.

methods.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache and logger dependencies.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Overrides the method to check if the user's session has been revoked and signs out if necessary.
